top_signals.title: Stocks Slip as AI Infrastructure IPO Flops, SpaceX Results Loom
top_signals.summary: The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index opened lower on Tuesday, as South Korean neocloud company Elice Inc.’s debut tanked, spurring concern about the sustainability of the global AI boom. Investors are also on edge ahead of a spate of tech earnings this week, including SpaceX and Netflix Inc. after the bell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
